title: Pricing with an Informed Buyer
abstract: arXiv:2602.18038v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study prior-independent pricing for a single seller and a single buyer when the seller has access to only one sample from the buyer's value distribution, whereas the buyer knows the distribution. Existing robust-pricing approaches either rely on distributional statistics, which may require many samples to estimate, or use realized samples to determine a price or mechanism before the buyer decides whether to purchase. We bridge these regimes by exploiting the buyer's informational advantage: policies that ordinarily require the seller to know a statistic such as the mean, an $L^\eta$-norm, or a superquantile can be implemented with a single private sample.   We introduce sample-contingent mechanisms: the seller commits ex ante to a transfer rule, and the buyer participates and reports before observing the sample. Subject to standard regularity conditions, every concave pricing policy is implementable in this way. To evaluate

translated_title: 面向知情买方的定价问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究单一卖方与单一买方之间的先验无关定价问题，其中卖方仅能获得买方价值分布的一个样本，而买方则完全了解该分布。现有的鲁棒定价方法要么依赖于分布统计量（这可能需要大量样本才能估计），要么在买方决定是否购买之前就利用已实现的样本确定价格或机制。我们通过利用买方的信息优势来弥合这两种机制之间的鸿沟：通常要求卖方知晓某个统计量（如均值、$L^\eta$-范数或超分位数）的定价策略，可以通过单个私有样本来实现。我们引入了样本依赖机制：卖方事先承诺一个转移支付规则，而买方在观察到样本之前参与并报告信息。在标准正则性条件下，每个凹定价策略都可以通过这种方式实现。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“样本依赖机制”，通过让卖方事先承诺转移支付规则、买方在观察样本前参与并报告，使得卖方仅凭买方价值分布的单个样本就能实现通常需要知道均值、范数或超分位数等统计量的定价策略，并证明在此框架下所有凹定价策略均可实现。
